subject: AcctSec follow-up — closure artifacts & compensating controls for PT findings
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clientcorp.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike O'Connor <mike.oconnor@clientcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test - closure artifacts request

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our security team finished their review of the pen test summary and had two follow-ups before we sign off the control closure: a) screenshots/config snippets showing the deployed fixes for the three high findings, and b) evidence tying each fix back to tickets (we prefer exports from your tracking system with ticket IDs and resolution notes).

Specific asks: 
- HTTP header hardening (Finding #H-003): screenshot of response headers from prod (curl -I output is fine) and the nginx conf lines you changed.
- Rate-limiter bypass (Finding #M-001): proof of the rule in the WAF and the Jira ticket where it was implemented.
- Privilege escalation (Finding #A-007): config or policy export showing the role changes + access_control_matrix indicating compensating controls during the rollout.

Can you send those artifacts by EOD Monday (PST)? We may need a brief 30-min follow-up to validate items.

Thanks — I know timelines are tight.

Emily Zhao
Security Program Manager
ClientCorp

On Thu, Mar 25, 2027 at 10:40 AM alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> (previous thread content omitted)
From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clientcorp.com>
Cc: Mike O'Connor <mike.oconnor@clientcorp.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test - closure artifacts request

Emily —

Appreciate the clear checklist. I'll coordinate the packet. Quick notes so expectations align:
- We'll provide curl -I outputs for the prod endpoints plus the nginx snippet lines (redacted where secrets/hostnames appear).
- For the WAF rules, we can export the rule JSON and attach the Jira export for the implementation ticket(s).
- For access/principle changes, Rishi will prepare a short access matrix (who/what/when) and add context on compensating controls applied during rollout.

Rishi, Vivek — looping you both in to own the technical artifacts and ticket exports respectively. Rishi, can you confirm whether we have a pre-built export for the role/policy changes or do you want to pull screenshots?

We'll upload a consolidated ZIP to a shared Drive and post the link here. If ClientCorp prefers a signed attestation or SOC2 reference, we can include a short note from Legal.

I'll aim to deliver the first pass by Monday EOD PST. If that slips, I'll flag earlier.

— Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clientcorp.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test - closure artifacts request

Emily / Alex —

Attached is the initial artifact bundle: pt_remediation_screenshots.zip (contains curl outputs and annotated screenshots), and jira_export_ClientCorp.csv (ticket IDs and resolution notes). Highlights: 

- Finding H-003 (header hardening): included curl -I to api.redwoodinference.com/health showing the updated Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy. nginx_conf-snippet.txt contains the exact lines added; we redacted internal upstream names.

- Finding M-001 (rate-limiter bypass): WAF rule id 62732 was deployed 2027-03-18; ticket RED-1426 documents the deployment and test evidence. Export includes WAF rule JSON snippet.

- Finding A-007 (privilege escalation): access_control_matrix_ClientCorp.pdf lists role mappings and temporary compensating control: we enforced required step-up authentication for privileged flows and added logging hooks to the admin endpoints during the rollout window. The matrix references ticket RED-1399 for the role change and RED-1401 for audit logging.

Open items: the access matrix contains a column with some UTC timestamps that our export shows as epoch — I can replace with readable timestamps if that helps your audit team.

Let me know if you need raw config diffs or additional screenshots from the canary environment.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: pt_remediation_screenshots.zip (28 MB), jira_export_ClientCorp.csv (text/csv), nginx_conf-snippet.txt (text/plain), access_control_matrix_ClientCorp.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@clientcorp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test - closure artifacts request

Emily —

Thanks for the quick review and confirm — per Rishi's bundle I uploaded the ZIP to the shared Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cexample (link has view-only).

Summary for your audit package: 
- All three high findings have concrete artifacts attached (screenshots, snippets, ticket exports).
- For the privilege escalation finding we also documented compensating controls: temporary step-up MFA, elevated logging retention, and post-deploy access review ticketing. See access_control_matrix_ClientCorp.pdf and RED-1399 / RED-1401 in the Jira export.

If you need a formal sign-off letter referencing our SOC 2 Type II scope or a statement from Legal about retention of the artifacts, I can request that and attach it to the Drive.

Next steps: if the artifacts satisfy ClientCorp, please reply to this thread with the final acceptance and we will close the items on our side. If you want a 30-minute screen share to walk through the evidence, I'm available Tue/Wed morning PST.

— Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
